title: Social media polarization during conflict: Insights from an ideological stance dataset on Israel-Palestine Reddit comments

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of various machine learning models, neural networks, and Large Language Models (LLMs) in detecting and classifying the ideological stance of Reddit comments regarding the Israel-Palestine conflict into Pro-Israel, Pro-Palestine, or Neutral categories using various prompting strategies (e.g., zero-shot, few-shot, and reflective re-read).
